summary.method: Every one of the 100 questions was re-read and answered independently, without reference to the printed key, and the printed key was then compared with the stored answer. Each explanation was rebuilt to a four-part standard: a concept-and-justification paragraph, per-option reasoning tied to that option's own text, revision facts, and a takeaway. A key was changed only where the evidence contradicts it and another option is demonstrably right; an item whose options cannot express the intended answer is flagged ambiguous rather than forced to a single letter. Five numbers the extraction never printed are app-authored model questions and are listed separately. Scan damage in option text was repaired only where the printed wording is certain.
